purpose: Remove all remaining ambiguity from candidate49 paper execution and future Rank IC settlement before the first registered signal, entry open, or outcome exists.

session_timing.signal_session: t, after the accepted close and atomic factor publication
session_timing.entry_session: the next accepted local session, t+1
session_timing.scheduled_exit_session: t+3, which is the third holding session when the t+1 entry session is counted as holding session one
session_timing.settlement_time: after the processed accepted session close and the daily source and price-basis gates pass
session_timing.processing_lag: an execution session is appended only after two later accepted local sessions exist in the local calendar, so every t+1 entry has an immutable t+3 scheduled exit before its lot is written; this calendar lag does not authorize reading a later session price before that later session is processed

portfolio.target_slot_notional: 5% of the shared portfolio equity frozen at the prior accepted close; the first entry uses CNY 200000
portfolio.maximum_gross_entry_notional_per_signal: 15% of the same prior-close equity before lot rounding
portfolio.selection_processing_order: registered rank ascending, then stock code ascending
portfolio.share_count: floor target slot notional to complete 100-share lots at the adverse-slippage entry price, then reduce by complete lots only if shared cash including fees is insufficient
portfolio.zero_affordable_lots: leave that registered slot in cash without replacement
portfolio.same_stock_from_different_signal_session: keep separate auditable lots; do not net their holding clocks

costs.fees_rounding: retain full floating-point precision in the ledger; presentation rounding cannot change state

tradeability.entry_blocked: missing or nonpositive raw_open, missing required row or prior close, nonpositive activity, or a one-price day with raw_open=raw_high=raw_low above the prior raw_close
tradeability.exit_blocked: missing or nonpositive raw_close, missing required row or prior close, nonpositive activity, or a one-price day with raw_close=raw_high=raw_low below the prior raw_close
tradeability.scheduled_exit_retry: retry at each later accepted close, for at most 20 total exit attempts including the scheduled t+3 close
tradeability.after_twenty_blocked_attempts: retain a marked terminal-unresolved paper position, stop further assumed fills, and fail the terminal-unresolved-position gate
tradeability.missing_mark: carry the last accepted mark only for portfolio accounting and record the stale mark; never treat it as an execution quote

capacity_and_affordability.daily_amount_participation: executed raw-price notional divided by that stock's same-session amount
capacity_and_affordability.entry_opportunity_denominator: every one of the three registered selections for every signal whose t+1 session is processed
capacity_and_affordability.board_lot_affordable_numerator: opportunities with at least one complete 100-share lot affordable under target, quote, tradeability, costs, and shared cash

future_rank_ic.factor_source: the immutable factor snapshot already bound by the signal ledger entry
future_rank_ic.outcome: raw_close on t+3 divided by raw_open on t+1 minus one
future_rank_ic.universe: all names marked eligible in that signal's immutable factor snapshot, not only Top3
future_rank_ic.valid_name: finite positive t+1 raw_open and t+3 raw_close on the accepted daily price basis
future_rank_ic.statistic: cross-sectional Spearman rank correlation with average ranks for ties
future_rank_ic.a_signal_counts_as_completed_for_rank_ic: only when at least 50 valid names exist at the fixed t+3 horizon

execution_ledger.append_granularity: one hash-linked entry per processed accepted local session
execution_ledger.state_reconstruction: cash and every open or terminal-unresolved lot must be reproducible from the complete prior hash chain
entry_fields: ending cash, marked positions, equity, drawdown, affordability, costs, and amount participation
execution_ledger.idempotent_rerun: an identical already-settled session performs no write; any differing source fingerprint or state is a hard stop

storage.symbol_scope: union of the session-active buyable universe, open paper positions, entering selections, and fixed-horizon Rank IC universes due on that session
storage.missing_symbol_row: write one explicit row with missing values and missing status; never omit, fill, or replace it
storage.atomic_publication: write Parquet and a fingerprint-bound manifest below a hidden partial directory, then rename the complete session directory once

evaluation.early_reject_only_if: mean future Rank IC <= 0 and primary-cost shared-portfolio net cumulative return <= 0
evaluation.passing_action: continue paper observation only; do not aggregate or place live orders

forbidden_actions: settle an execution session before its accepted close
use adjusted Qlib execution prices instead of frozen raw daily prices
spend same-close exit proceeds at the earlier same-session open
use same-session amount as a fill guarantee
change costs, slippage, holding horizon, tradeability, ranking, TopK, or sizing after an outcome
place or imply a live order
